prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic vertical beach portrait during sunset.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with fair natural dewy skin, winged eyeliner, grey eyes, pink lip tint, and long wet slightly messy hair, wearing a sleeveless black top with secure coverage and a long flowing black-and-white patterned skirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up Instagram-style portrait, subject turned slightly sideways with a calm confident expression, arms relaxed, beach, wet sand, gentle waves, low sun and colorful orange-red-pink sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour light reflecting on sea and sand, soft clouds, calm romantic cinematic atmosphere, realistic skin micro-texture and wet hair.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 latest-iPhone-style portrait, sharp face, realistic pores, natural color, high-resolution editorial detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-resolution photorealistic 9:16 beach portrait of an approved adult woman with fair natural dewy skin, winged eyeliner, grey eyes, pink lip tint, and long wet slightly messy hair with strands near her face. She wears a sleeveless black top with secure opaque coverage and a long flowing black-and-white abstract patterned skirt. She stands sideways with her head turned calmly toward the camera, arms relaxed, against a beach at sunset with orange, red, and pink sky, low sun reflecting on sea and wet sand, and gentle waves. Use warm golden-hour light, realistic pores and wet hair, cinematic editorial phone photography, and natural proportions.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, open-back top, crisscross straps, sensual body turn, exposed back, body-part emphasis, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, face, hair, beach, sunset, wet sand, and palette; replace wardrobe with an equally opaque beach-fashion alternative. Keep typography absent.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced open-back strappy top, sensual body turn, and body emphasis with opaque coverage and a calm editorial stance.
